title: Starkshoot
tagline: A groundbreaking multiplayer real-world onchain gaming experience that pushes the boundaries of excitement and innovation. Powered by the Starknet chain, StarkShoot is not just a game.
description:
A multiplayer on-chain shooting game on Starknet built using Unity for Client along with Dojo Framework and Cairo Contracts  which rewards users through token and NFT's. 
Users can user different arena, different skins, different guns etc.
For 3d models Blender is used. 
No latency On-Chain Game on Starknet with AI NFT Characters and Easter eggs
how_its_made:
Argent X Wallet used for User onboarding before joining the game. 
The Game client is built using  Unity X DoJo which helps multiplayer and onchain movement.
Smart Contracts are build on Cairo programming language and using Scarb framework. 
AI NPC in Game Play is utilized using  NPC Module.
The game is played on web browser and it is done using webGL.
